answer: Because the thread index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the sable audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 91 aliases hence needs 91 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a harbor index of commitments rather than against the text alone. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
